christopher-boedeker.notes_append: Official bio (Johnson County, fetched 2026-08-16): Judge Boedeker and his wife, Andrea, are life-long residents of Johnson County. profile.background: Collin County Judge (elected 2018). Previously Collin County Commissioner, Precinct 3 (2012, 2016). Sixth-generation Texan and fourth-generation Collin County resident. Former executive pastor and corporate accountant/controller. CPA, CIA, CGMA, CFE. Official county page lists Texas Home School Coalition membership and Life Member of the National Rifle Association; board service includes Hope Women's Center and The Samaritan Inn.

chris-hill.notes_append: Official bio (Collin County, fetched 2026-08-16): Chris Hill was elected to serve as the Collin County Judge in 2018, having been previously elected as the county commissioner for Precinct 3 in 2012 and 2016. Chris is a sixth-generation native Texan and a fourth-generation resident of Collin County. Prior to his election he served as an Executive Pastor and worked as a corporate accountant and controller. He is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Chartered Global Management Accountant (CGMA), and Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE). Official page also lists Texas Home School Coalition membership and Life Member of the National Rifle Association. Roster scaffold — not scored.

profile.background: Hunt County Judge. Official county page: executive officer of Hunt County; chief administrator and budget officer; presides over Commissioners Court and is a voting member; oversees the agenda process and meeting notice.

bobby-w-stovall.notes_append: Official role statement (Hunt County, fetched 2026-08-16): The County Judge is the executive officer of Hunt County. This position requires that the elected individual act as chief administrator and budget officer for the entire county. The County Judge presides over the Commissioners' Court, and is a voting member of the Hunt County Commissioners' Court. Roster scaffold — not scored.
